title: Make the run-id suffix longer, or retry on a directory collision, so a wave of runs started in one second cannot collide

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The implementer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-194833-6309, project ork, item S631:

Make the run-id suffix longer, or retry on a directory collision, so a wave of runs started in one second cannot collide

Evidence: internal/engine/engine.go:121 uses 2 random bytes; TestWaveHeldMemberStartsAfterTheEarlierLands failed once with "mkdir ...runs/ork-20261127-205645-9e55: file exists" and passed 33 reruns
